svg.title: RMS and peak scales of a 230 volt RMS sinusoid
svg.desc: One period of a sinusoidal voltage is plotted against a voltage axis. Dashed horizontal lines mark plus and minus 230 volts RMS. The waveform reaches plus and minus 230 times the square root of two, approximately plus and minus 325.3 volts.
